network.definition: An isolated virtual network environment dedicated to a cloud account.

container.definition: A lightweight, standalone, executable package that runs an application (Serverless containers).

serverless.definition: An event-driven, serverless computing platform that executes code in response to events.

block_storage.definition: Scalable, persistent block storage volumes for use with virtual machines.

object_storage.definition: An internet-scale, distributed object storage service for unstructured data.

database.definition: A managed relational database service supporting engines like MySQL, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server.

nosql_database.definition: A fully managed NoSQL key-value and document database service.

identity_access.definition: A framework of policies and technologies for ensuring that the proper users have the appropriate access to technology resources.

provider.azure: Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD) & Azure RBAC

governance.definition: A logical container used to organize, isolate, and manage access to cloud resources.

load_balancing.definition: A service that automatically distributes incoming application traffic across multiple targets.

dns.definition: A highly available and scalable Domain Name System web service.
